components.name: ResearchHeader
components.summary: The top of every EV+ infographic: mono kicker, claim-style headline, mono subhead, logo top-right.

components.name: Panel
components.summary: A plate on the page that holds one idea: a title, a caption subtitle, then content.

components.name: StepCard
components.summary: One numbered step in a how-it-works sequence, used in rows of three inside a Panel.

components.name: BarChart
components.summary: Scenario or category bars with the value printed above each bar: the EV+ bear / base / bull chart.

components.name: Stat
components.summary: A big number with a short label and a qualifier, shown in rows of two to four.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: A small mono label for status or category: one or two words, uppercase.

components.name: SourceFooter
components.summary: The required last block of every EV+ infographic: where the data came from and what is assumed.

components.name: Sticker
components.summary: A Terminal-face stamp: phosphor pixel type on terminal black with CRT glow, for X posts, Telegram, thumbnails and merch.
